note: Frozen ex ante. Specificity battery: the localized-transition gate must stay silent on adversarial non-transition processes while still flagging genuine bifurcations. Never adjusted post-hoc to match observed data.

verdict_tokens.STRONG_NEGATIVES_CLEAN: localized FPR <= fpr_max AND bifurcation TPR >= tpr_min

shipped_result.interpretation: The localized gate fires on 0/11 strong negatives (incl. unit-root random walk, AR(1) red noise, 1/f noise, sinusoid, sawtooth) while the bare sustained-crossing gate leaks on 54.5% of them, and both genuine bifurcations are still flagged.

rationale: fpr_max=0.10 allows at most a single marginal false positive across an 11-process adversarial battery; tpr_min=0.50 guards against a trivially-silent detector. A LEAK is an honest negative reported at equal status to CLEAN (see docs/EVIDENCE_LADDER.md rung 7).
